caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a rectangular frame and a seat cushion. The chair is shown from the front in a realistic style, with its wooden structure colored in shades of brown. The backrest features geometric cutouts and a central circular rosette design. The chair arms are curved and supported by vertical posts that connect to the seat. The legs are turned and tapered, with the front legs featuring decorative detailing, and there is a horizontal support connecting the legs below the seat. The seat itself is covered with a blue cushion that has a subtle gradient effect, darkening at the edges. Below the main depiction, the bottom left corner includes a small, top-down view of the blue cushion encased in the chair’s wooden frame. In the bottom right corner, there is a side elevation drawing of the chair, rendered in the same brown color, showing its profile and labeled with a vertical dimension of 3 feet 8 inches. The background of the drawing is off-white, and there are no additional objects other than the chair and the two smaller inset drawings.
title: Chair
